verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents instant virtual card creation and lets you set card names, spending limits and reset intervals, plus card controls and embedded expense policies. However, nothing shows locking a card to a specific purpose, such as a merchant category (ad spend) or a single vendor; naming and capping a card is only a soft approximation of that scoping. Missing for 10: documented merchant/vendor locking or category restrictions per virtual card, and independent or hands-on corroboration of instant purpose-scoped issuance.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can instantly create virtual cards scoped to a specific purpose like ad spend or a single vendor
